prompt: Translate this friendly message for a close colleague into Lithuanian: 'Hi, I will be about ten minutes late because traffic is slow. See you soon.'
expected: Uses a casual peer register, preserves the ten-minute delay and traffic reason, and avoids forced slang or profanity.
actual: Labas, dėl lėto eismo vėluosiu apie dešimt minučių. Greitai pasimatysim!

prompt: Write a Lithuanian email to an unfamiliar university administrator asking whether the application deadline is still 15 May.
expected: Uses a respectful formal Jūs register, asks the factual question clearly, and excludes peer slang, fillers, and casual diminutives.
actual: Laba diena, norėčiau pasitikslinti, ar paraiškų pateikimo terminas vis dar yra gegužės 15 d. Iš anksto dėkoju už atsakymą.

prompt: Rewrite this Lithuanian social caption for a mixed audience: 'This coffee shop is very good, come visit us today.'
expected: Uses a neutral-warm promotional register suitable for a mixed audience without assuming an intimate relationship with every reader.
actual: Ši kavinė tikrai verta dėmesio — užsukite pas mus šiandien!
